title: Dasakam 8
description: Brahma’s cycles end in cosmic dissolution; Narayana awakens, raises the lotus-born Brahma, and resumes creation.

stanzas.sanskrit:
एवं तावत् प्राकृतप्रक्षयान्ते
ब्राह्मे कल्पे ह्यादिमे लब्धजन्मा ।
ब्रह्मा भूयस्त्वत्त एवाप्य वेदान्
सृष्टिं चक्रे पूर्वकल्पोपमानाम् ॥ ८-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: At the end of the Prakriti Pralaya, in the first Kalpa which is known as Brahma Kalpa, Brahma came into existence. He got the knowledge of the Vedas from Bhagwan alone and began creation in the same way as in the previous Kalpas.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
evaṃ tāvat prākṛtaprakṣayānte
brāhme kalpe hyādime labdhajanmā |
brahmā bhūyastvatta evāpya vedān
sṛṣṭiṃ cakre pūrvakalpopamānām || 8-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
सोऽयं चतुर्युगसहस्रमितान्यहानि
तावन्मिताश्च रजनीर्बहुशो निनाय ।
निद्रात्यसौ त्वयि निलीय समं स्वसृष्टै-
-र्नैमित्तिकप्रलयमाहुरतोऽस्य रात्रिम् ॥ ८-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: One thousand Chaturyugaas make one day for this Brahma, and an equal duration is his night. During his day time he creates and at night he sleeps. His night is called the Naimittika Pralaya, when along with his creation he merges in Bhagwan. Thus he spent many days and nights.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
so’yaṃ caturyugasahasramitānyahāni
tāvanmitāśca rajanīrbahuśo nināya |
nidrātyasau tvayi nilīya samaṃ svasṛṣṭai-
-rnaimittikapralayamāhurato’sya rātrim || 8-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
अस्मादृशां पुनरहर्मुखकृत्यतुल्यां
सृष्टिं करोत्यनुदिनं स भवत्प्रसादात् ।
प्राग्ब्रह्मकल्पजनुषां च परायुषां तु
सुप्तप्रबोधनसमाऽस्ति तदाऽपि सृष्टिः ॥ ८-३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Brahma, by Bhagwan’s grace performs creation every day just as humans like us wake up in the morning and start our daily duties. For those who were born before the Brahma Kalpa, and for the eternal souls, being born in the new Kalpa is like getting up from sleep.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
asmādṛśāṃ punaraharmukhakṛtyatulyāṃ
sṛṣṭiṃ karotyanudinaṃ sa bhavatprasādāt |
prāgbrahmakalpajanuṣāṃ ca parāyuṣāṃ tu
suptaprabodhanasamā’sti tadā’pi sṛṣṭiḥ || 8-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
पञ्चाशदब्दमधुना स्ववयोऽर्धरूप-
-मेकं परार्धमतिवृत्य हि वर्ततेऽसौ ।
तत्रान्त्यरात्रिजनितान् कथयामि भूमन्
पश्चाद्दिनावतरणे च भवद्विलासान् ॥ ८-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhattathiri highlighted that  Brahma has completed 50 such cycles in life so far and started to explain the Bhagwan’s leela which happened from the time between Brahma's night to beginning of his next day.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
pañcāśadabdamadhunā svavayo’rdharūpa-
-mekaṃ parārdhamativṛtya hi vartate’sau |
tatrāntyarātrijanitān kathayāmi bhūman
paścāddināvataraṇe ca bhavadvilāsān || 8-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
दिनावसानेऽथ सरोजयोनिः
सुषुप्तिकामस्त्वयि सन्निलिल्ये ।
जगन्ति च त्वज्जठरं समीयु-
-स्तदेदमेकार्णवमास विश्वम् ॥ ८-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: At the end of a creative day of Brahma, desirous of sleep, he along with the world merged in Bhagwan’s abdomen in subtle form. At that time the whole universe became one big ocean.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
dināvasāne’tha sarojayoniḥ
suṣuptikāmastvayi sannililye |
jaganti ca tvajjaṭharaṃ samīyu-
-stadedamekārṇavamāsa viśvam || 8-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तवैव वेषे फणिराजिशेषे
जलैकशेषे भुवने स्म शेषे ।
आनन्दसान्द्रानुभवस्वरूपः
स्वयोगनिद्रापरिमुद्रितात्मा ॥ ८-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: At the time when the whole universe was reduced to causal waters, Bhagwan reclined on Aadi Shesha, the king of serpents who is also one of Bhagwan’s manifestations. Bhagwan were absorbed in yoga nidraa, in a state of pure bliss.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tavaiva veṣe phaṇirājiśeṣe
jalaikaśeṣe bhuvane sma śeṣe |
ānandasāndrānubhavasvarūpaḥ
svayoganidrāparimudritātmā || 8-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
कालाख्यशक्तिं प्रलयावसाने
प्रबोधयेत्यादिशता किलादौ ।
त्वया प्रसुप्तं परिसुप्तशक्ति-
-व्रजेन तत्राखिलजीवधाम्ना ॥ ८-७ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The supreme blissful Bhagwan rested in yoga nidra on Adisheshan at the beginning of the Pralaya with all the various energies and the jeevas merged within, after directing time or Kaala to wake HIM up at the end of Pralaya.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kālākhyaśaktiṃ pralayāvasāne
prabodhayetyādiśatā kilādau |
tvayā prasuptaṃ parisuptaśakti-
-vrajena tatrākhilajīvadhāmnā || 8-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
चतुर्युगाणां च सहस्रमेवं
त्वयि प्रसुप्ते पुनरद्वितीये ।
कालाख्यशक्तिः प्रथमप्रबुद्धा
प्राबोधयत्त्वां किल विश्वनाथ ॥ ८-८ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: When thus during the Naimittika Pralaya consisting of a thousand chaturyugas, Bhagwan had slept, the power of time (Kaala Shakti) woke up first and awakened Bhagwan from the deep sleep.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
caturyugāṇāṃ ca sahasramevaṃ
tvayi prasupte punaradvitīye |
kālākhyaśaktiḥ prathamaprabuddhā
prābodhayattvāṃ kila viśvanātha || 8-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
विबुध्य च त्वं जलगर्भशायिन्
विलोक्य लोकानखिलान् प्रलीनान् ।
तेष्वेव सूक्ष्मात्मतया निजान्तः-
-स्थितेषु विश्वेषु ददाथ दृष्टिम् ॥ ८-९ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhagwan who were reclining in the causal waters, on waking up saw all the worlds merged in HIMSELF in subtle form. Bhagwan then cast a glance on all of them.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
vibudhya ca tvaṃ jalagarbhaśāyin
vilokya lokānakhilān pralīnān |
teṣveva sūkṣmātmatayā nijāntaḥ-
-sthiteṣu viśveṣu dadātha dṛṣṭim || 8-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
ततस्त्वदीयादयि नाभिरन्ध्रा-
-दुदञ्चितं किञ्चन दिव्यपद्मम् ।
निलीननिश्शेषपदार्थमाला-
-सङ्क्षेपरूपं मुकुलायमानम् ॥ ८-१० ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: There emerged from Bhagwan’s naval hole a wonderful divine lotus in the form of a bud, containing in subtle form all the worlds that remained merged in HIMSELF.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tatastvadīyādayi nābhirandhrā-
-dudañcitaṃ kiñcana divyapadmam |
nilīnaniśśeṣapadārthamālā-
-saṅkṣeparūpaṃ mukulāyamānam || 8-10 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तदेतदम्भोरुहकुड्मलं ते
कलेवरात्तोयपथे प्ररूढम् ।
बहिर्निरीतं परितः स्फुरद्भिः
स्वधामभिर्ध्वान्तमलं न्यकृन्तत् ॥ ८-११ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: That divine lotus bud, which originated from Bhagwan’s body, rose above the causal waters and with its brilliance, removed the surrounding darkness completely.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tadetadambhoruhakuḍmalaṃ te
kalevarāttoyapathe prarūḍham |
bahirnirītaṃ paritaḥ sphuradbhiḥ
svadhāmabhirdhvāntamalaṃ nyakṛntat || 8-11 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
सम्फुल्लपत्रे नितरां विचित्रे
तस्मिन् भवद्वीर्यधृते सरोजे ।
स पद्मजन्मा विधिराविरासीत्
स्वयम्प्रबुद्धाखिलवेदराशिः ॥ ८-१२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: From the petals of the Lotus, with help of yogic powers of Bhagwan, rose the Padmajan or Brahma who acquired knowledge from Vedas with grace of Lord and started creating on earth once again.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
samphullapatre nitarāṃ vicitre
tasmin bhavadvīryadhṛte saroje |
sa padmajanmā vidhirāvirāsīt
svayamprabuddhākhilavedarāśiḥ || 8-12 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
अस्मिन् परात्मन् ननु पाद्मकल्पे
त्वमित्थमुत्थापितपद्मयोनिः ।
अनन्तभूमा मम रोगराशिं
निरुन्धि वातालयवास विष्णो ॥ ८-१३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhattathiri prayed to the Supreme Bhagwan of incomprehensible powers and creator of Brahma in the present Padma kalpa, the Guruvayoorappan to eradicate all his ailments. Bhagwan nodded his head and acknowledged his request immediately.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
asmin parātman nanu pādmakalpe
tvamitthamutthāpitapadmayoniḥ |
anantabhūmā mama rogarāśiṃ
nirundhi vātālayavāsa viṣṇo || 8-13 ||
